name: IAM Permissions Boundary Weakening
description: An attacker with iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary or iam:PutUserPermissionsBoundary can replace an existing permissions boundary with a weaker one. The new boundary may grant broader actions (e.g., s3:* instead of s3:GetObject only) or cover more resources. This effectively escalates the principal's permissions without modifying attached policies. Required permissions are iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary for roles or iam:PutUserPermissionsBoundary for users.
detectionStrategy: Weakening is often not directly inferable from a single CloudTrail event unless the system knows approved boundary ARNs. Detection should focus on change visibility, non-approved boundary ARNs, sensitive targets, and suspicious follow-on behavior. Use allowlists for approved boundary policies where possible.
